pages.title: Soot Sprite with Wide Eyes and a Fuzzy Round Body Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite with wide eyes and a fuzzy round body fills this printable coloring page, centered alone against a completely open background with a bold outline. Its two large circular eyes and smaller pupils create simple enclosed shapes inside the many pointed tufts.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Carrying Star-shaped Konpeito Candy Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite carries star-shaped konpeito candy on this printable coloring page, lifting the large sweet above its fuzzy body with both long arms fully extended. Thin legs, scattered stones, and leafy plants add small details beneath and beside the central figure.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Sharing Konpeito Candy with a Friend Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite shares konpeito candy with a friend on this printable coloring page, with the two fuzzy figures holding opposite sides of one sweet together. More star-shaped candies lie across the floor, while wooden boards and a large curved structure form the background.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Catching Konpeito Candy Tossed By Lin Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite catches konpeito candy tossed by Lin on this printable coloring page, leaping with raised arms as she scatters sweets from a woven basket. Curved flight lines cross the space between them, with wooden decking, rails, and bushes surrounding the scene.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Peeking From a Jar of Star-shaped Candy Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite peeks from a jar of star-shaped candy on this printable coloring page, gripping the rim above a pile of overlapping sweets inside the container. The round lid leans nearby, and two loose candies rest on the lightly lined tabletop.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Searching for Konpeito Candy Between Lumps of Coal Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite searches for konpeito candy between lumps of coal on this printable coloring page, reaching down toward a small sweet beneath its wide eyes. Large angular coal pieces and scattered fragments frame the fuzzy figure, with cracking lines dividing their surfaces.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Eating Konpeito Candy Beside the Boiler-room Wall Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite eats konpeito candy beside the boiler-room wall on this printable coloring page, holding a sweet close while two other sprites peek from behind panels. A candy bowl, floor tiles, pipes, and a riveted furnace door provide varied surrounding details.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Offering Konpeito Candy to No-face Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite offers konpeito candy to No-Face on this printable coloring page, stretching its little arms toward the seated figure on a wooden porch step. No-Face's mask markings and draped body create broad shapes above the sprite, with plants and floorboards nearby.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Carrying Coal to Kamaji's Furnace Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite carries coal to Kamaji's furnace on this printable coloring page, stepping toward the arched opening with a large angular lump held in both hands. A coal-filled barrel, wheel valve, pipes, and rows of rivets complete the busy boiler-room setting.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Waiting as Chihiro Lifts a Fallen Coal Lump Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite waits as Chihiro lifts a fallen coal lump on this printable coloring page, watching her crouch beside scattered pieces near the furnace and bucket. Her striped shirt, ponytail, sandals, and extended hand add character details against the wooden room.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Leaving Its Coal at Chihiro's Feet Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite leaves its coal at Chihiro's feet on this printable coloring page, lowering the angular lump while she watches with her hands clasped together. Wooden floorboards and a large riveted furnace frame the two figures, with clear spaces in her shirt and shorts.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Standing with Its Friends Around Chihiro When Kamaji Scolds Her Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite stands with its friends around Chihiro as Kamaji scolds her on this printable coloring page, his many arms visible above the wooden counter. Three little sprites gather by her shoes, with a bucket, lidded jar, pipes, and furnace behind them.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Carrying Chihiro's Shoes Into Its Wall Burrow Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite carries Chihiro's shoes toward its wall burrow on this printable coloring page, working with another sprite to move a large laced shoe across the floor. The rounded burrow opening and long wood-grain lines surround the footwear's bow, eyelets, and sole.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Returning Chihiro's Shoes Before Her Journey Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite returns Chihiro's shoes before her journey on this printable coloring page, holding one up as she kneels on a wooden deck in her socks. A bridge rail, leafy trees, and the bathhouse's layered roofs fill the background with smaller architectural details.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Waving Goodbye as Chihiro Follows Lin Upstairs Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite waves goodbye as Chihiro follows Lin upstairs on this printable coloring page, raising one hand at the foot of a long wooden staircase. The two girls look back beneath hanging lanterns, while rails, wall beams, and floorboards create straight-lined sections.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Watching Kamaji Grind Herbs Beside the Furnace Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite watches Kamaji grind herbs beside the furnace on this printable coloring page, holding a leafy sprig near trays spread across the wooden floor. Kamaji's many hands carry herbs around a mortar and pestle, with jars, pipes, and furnace flames behind him.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Blocking the Cursed Slug as Chihiro Approaches Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite blocks the cursed slug as Chihiro approaches on this printable coloring page, spreading its arms while two friends stand nearby on the wooden floor. The slug's raised feelers, Chihiro's reaching hand, and a large jar add distinct shapes around the group.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Watching Boh the Mouse Copy Chihiro's Footsteps Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite watches Boh the mouse copy Chihiro's footsteps on this printable coloring page, standing behind the little mouse as he lifts one foot on the bridge. Wide ears, outstretched arms, wooden rails, and the bathhouse roofs create a detailed setting.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Keeping Watch Beside Haku Resting in the Boiler Room Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite keeps watch beside Haku resting in the boiler room on this printable coloring page, holding coal near the sleeping figure's blanket and floor cushion. A barrel, bucket, loose lumps, pipes, gauge, and large furnace fill the surrounding space.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Resting with Kamaji Beside the Coal Pile Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite rests with Kamaji beside the coal pile on this printable coloring page, sitting in front of the furnace while Kamaji settles behind it. A shovel, coal bucket, round gauge, and angular lumps provide smaller details around the seated figures.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Sharing Its Candy Break with Boh and the Tiny Bird Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite shares its candy break with Boh and the tiny bird on this printable coloring page, each holding a star-shaped sweet beside an open jar. Loose candies, the jar lid, leafy plants, and surrounding rocks create smaller details around the three rounded figures.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Climbing the Boiler-room Ladder Beside Chihiro Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite climbs the boiler-room ladder beside Chihiro on this printable coloring page, gripping a lower rung while she looks back from farther up. Pipes, a wheel valve, wooden wall panels, and the large riveted boiler frame the tall ladder.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Scurrying From Sunlight as Satsuki Opens the Farmhouse Window Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite scurries from sunlight as Satsuki opens the farmhouse window on this printable coloring page, moving across the floor beneath the wide open shutters. Diagonal rays, outdoor trees, wooden boards, and a chest of drawers add detail around the two figures.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Escaping Through the Farmhouse Wall Crack as Mei Reaches Inside Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite escapes through the farmhouse wall crack as Mei reaches toward it on this printable coloring page, crouching close with one hand extended near the opening. A low bench, storage jar, window, and wooden floorboards fill the room around her.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Climbing Toward the Attic Rafters with Its Friends Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite climbs toward the attic rafters with its friends on this printable coloring page, floating upward beneath the broad wooden beams and sloping roof boards. Three differently sized fuzzy bodies and curved movement lines stand out against the open space below the rafters.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Resting in Mei's Cupped Hands in the Farmhouse Attic Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite rests in Mei's cupped hands in the farmhouse attic on this printable coloring page, centered beneath her smiling face as she kneels on the floor. A storage chest, woven basket, open jar, and roof beams provide surrounding details to color.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Watching Granny Explain the Farmhouse's Dust Spirits to Mei Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite watches Granny explain the farmhouse's dust spirits to Mei on this printable coloring page, hovering beside a beam above their conversation near the table. Granny gestures with an open hand, surrounded by shelves, jars, chairs, and clearly outlined wooden boards.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Listening to Mei and Satsuki Laugh During the Nighttime Storm Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite listens to Mei and Satsuki laugh during a nighttime storm on this printable coloring page, peeking over a ceiling beam above their bedding. Rain streaks the window behind them, while Mei hugs a pillow beside a lantern and wooden cabinet.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Floating Out of the Farmhouse Toward the Camphor Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite floats out of the farmhouse toward the camphor tree on this printable coloring page, joining a curving line of friends above the garden path. Tiled roofs, layered bushes, and the giant branching tree fill the scene with varied woodland and house details.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Settling Into a Hollow Beneath the Camphor Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite settles into a hollow beneath the camphor tree on this printable coloring page, sitting among fallen leaves inside an opening formed by thick roots. Flowing bark lines, small stones, and leafy shoots surround its round fuzzy body and wide eyes.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Watching Small Totoro Slip Through a Gap in the Garden Fence Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite watches Small Totoro slip through a gap in the garden fence on this printable coloring page, leaning on a rock beside the narrow trail. Broad leaves climb beside the wooden boards, with grass, stones, and bushes framing Totoro's departing figure.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Following Mei Through the Leafy Tunnel to Totoro Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite follows Mei through the leafy tunnel to Totoro on this printable coloring page, moving along the path as she approaches the large waiting creature. Interwoven branches and overlapping leaves form a detailed arch around the three figures and scattered trail stones.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Watching Over Lost Mei Beside a Roadside Jizo Statue Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite watches over lost Mei beside a roadside Jizo statue on this printable coloring page, holding a leaf above its head while standing on a rock. Mei sits with her knees drawn up, surrounded by flowers, stepping stones, trees, and distant hills.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Resting on Sleeping Totoro's Belly in the Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite rests on sleeping Totoro's belly in the forest on this printable coloring page, sitting above the large creature's chevron markings beneath its closed eyes. Totoro's broad paws and foot pads fill the foreground, with flowers, leaves, and a tree behind him.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Sheltering Under Totoro's Umbrella at the Rainy Bus Stop Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite shelters under Totoro's umbrella at a rainy bus stop on this printable coloring page, standing by his feet beside the round roadside sign. Raindrops and puddles repeat around them, with broad canopy sections above and small bushes behind.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Watching Totoro's Seedlings Grow Into a Giant Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite watches Totoro's seedlings grow into a giant tree on this printable coloring page, standing beside a progression from small sprout to tall leafy trunk. Totoro looks on from behind, with grass tufts, rounded stones, bushes, and clouds completing the scene.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Riding Beside Totoro on His Flying Spinning Top Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite rides beside Totoro on his flying spinning top on this printable coloring page, sitting near the edge while Totoro faces forward with his paws visible. Wide curved stripes wrap around the pointed top, and rounded clouds gather beneath the airborne pair.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Peeking From a Catbus Window Above the Treetops Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite peeks from a Catbus window above the treetops on this printable coloring page, looking out as the grinning creature travels through the cloudy sky. Rows of seats, striped legs, a curled tail, distant hills, and layered tree crowns add surrounding details.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Helping Small Totoro Gather an Acorn Beside a Tree Root Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite helps Small Totoro gather an acorn beside a tree root on this printable coloring page, with both creatures reaching around the large nut. Its patterned cap, scattered leaves, pebbles, and the tree's sweeping bark lines add detail around their simple bodies.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Chasing Acorns Spilling From Medium Totoro's Sack Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite chases acorns spilling from Medium Totoro's sack on this printable coloring page, running with outstretched arms as the nuts roll along the woodland path. Curved movement marks surround the acorns, while bushes, grass, and a tree frame the action.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Sheltering Beneath a Mushroom Cap During a Forest Shower Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite shelters beneath a mushroom cap during a forest shower on this printable coloring page, sitting beside the tall stem under its wide spotted canopy. Visible gills, large raindrops, grass blades, and puddles surround the little figure's thin arms and legs.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Resting in a Curled Autumn Leaf Beside Woodland Mushrooms Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite rests in a curled autumn leaf beside woodland mushrooms on this printable coloring page, nestled within the broad veined edges of the fallen foliage. Two tall mushrooms rise behind it, with smaller leaves, stones, and sparse plants across the ground.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Collecting Pollen From a Flower in a Woodland Clearing Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite collects pollen from a flower in a woodland clearing on this printable coloring page, reaching toward the bloom's long stamens with both little hands. Broad petals and veined leaves fill the foreground, with trunks, bushes, grass, and stones behind.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Watching a Butterfly Land on a Daisy Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite watches a butterfly land on a daisy on this printable coloring page, standing on a rock with its small hands held together. The butterfly's divided wings and the flower's separate petals add details above the surrounding grass and smaller blooms.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Peeking Between Fern Fronds in a Mossy Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite peeks between fern fronds in a mossy forest on this printable coloring page, its wide eyes visible among overlapping rows of scalloped leaflets. Mushrooms, rounded moss patches, and a textured tree trunk fill the background, making the surrounding plants more detailed than the central face.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Crossing a Fallen Twig Beside Woodland Mushrooms Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite crosses a fallen twig beside woodland mushrooms on this printable coloring page, balancing with little arms spread above the broken piece of wood. Two spotted caps, radiating gills, tall leaves, grass, and scattered stones surround the narrow crossing.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Meeting a Snail on a Rain-damp Camphor Leaf Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite meets a snail on a rain-damp camphor leaf on this printable coloring page, facing its spiral shell beneath another broad leaf hanging overhead. Rounded water drops and branching veins decorate the leaves, with the snail's long feelers extending toward the sprite.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Holding a Fallen Cherry Blossom Beneath a Flowering Branch Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite holds a fallen cherry blossom beneath a flowering branch on this printable coloring page, gripping the large bloom with both hands near its fuzzy body. Buds and open flowers decorate the branch above, with loose petals, bushes, rocks, and grass below.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Following Fireflies Around the Camphor Tree at Night Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite follows fireflies around the camphor tree at night on this printable coloring page, lifting one hand as it steps across a broad exposed root. Dotted looping trails and short glow marks surround three insects, with leaves and bark lines framing the scene.

pages.title: Soot Sprite Catching a Drifting Dandelion Seed Above a Meadow Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite catches a drifting dandelion seed above a meadow on this printable coloring page, hanging from the long stem with one hand as its feet lift. Fine seed threads spread overhead, with flowers, dandelion heads, bushes, and rolling ground below.

pages.title: Totoro Soot Sprites Under Giant Camphor Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: Totoro sits with soot sprites under a giant camphor tree on this printable coloring page, holding an umbrella as little fuzzy figures gather among roots and branches. His large belly and foot pads contrast with the many leaves, thin limbs, and flowing bark details.

pages.title: Totoro Soot Sprites Among Autumn Leaves Coloring Page
pages.description: Totoro and soot sprites gather among autumn leaves on this printable coloring page, with Totoro holding a lobed leaf above the foliage piled around his feet. Small sprites dot the pile and float beside him, while varied leaf veins add finer sections to color.

pages.title: Totoro Soot Sprites in Bamboo Grove Coloring Page
pages.description: Totoro and soot sprites stand in a bamboo grove on this printable coloring page, with little figures raising their arms around Totoro's broad grin and patterned belly. Tall jointed stalks and narrow leaves form the background, and a small leaf rests between his ears.

pages.title: Totoro Soot Sprites in Magical Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: Totoro and soot sprites appear in a magical forest on this printable coloring page, framed by tall trees with little fuzzy figures floating among the branches. Mushrooms, ferns, broad leaves, and exposed roots add detailed borders around Totoro's large central body.

pages.title: Totoro Soot Sprites Beside Acorn Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: Totoro and soot sprites gather beside an acorn tree on this printable coloring page, with Totoro holding a tiny umbrella while the sprites cluster near the trunk. Acorns hang among lobed leaves above them, and fallen nuts, leaves, pebbles, and grass cover the ground.

pages.title: Totoro Soot Sprites in Sunflower Field Coloring Page
pages.description: A soot sprite floats in a sunflower field on this printable coloring page, raising one little arm among tall flower stems and scattered star-shaped details around its fuzzy body. Broad petals and leaves surround it, while a sun peeks between rounded clouds overhead.

pages.title: Totoro Soot Sprites in Forest at Dawn Coloring Page
pages.description: Totoro and soot sprites rest in a forest at dawn on this printable coloring page, with one sprite perched between his ears and another beside his foot. A rising sun, winding trail, tall trees, and leafy branches create a setting around the seated figure.

pages.title: Totoro Soot Sprites Near Country Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: Totoro and soot sprites gather near a country garden on this printable coloring page, with the little creatures clustered along a path beneath Totoro's broad smiling face. Flowers, a picket fence, a planted bed, and a small house fill the surrounding countryside scene.

pages.title: Totoro Soot Sprites Inside Hollow Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: Totoro sits with soot sprites inside a hollow tree on this printable coloring page, framed by a large opening whose bark edges are crowded with little fuzzy figures. Knots and flowing wood-grain lines surround his broad belly, while a leaf rests between his ears.

pages.title: Totoro Soot Sprites Among Wildflowers Coloring Page
pages.description: Totoro and soot sprites stand among wildflowers on this printable coloring page, with small creatures perched around his ears and floating near the leafy sprig he holds. Daisies, bell-shaped blooms, buds, and grass form a dense floral border below his open belly shape.
